summary_en: Japan Securities Finance raised interim dividend to 56 yen per share (vs. 47 yen forecast) for fiscal year ending March 2027, and revised full-year dividend forecast to 112 yen per share (vs. 94 yen) on upward revision of earnings guidance. The increases reflect commitment to 70% dividend payout ratio target under total shareholder return policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision (Increase) of Surplus Dividend (Interim Dividend) and Full-Year Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd. announced on November 12, 2026, a revision to its dividend forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased the interim dividend (with record date September 30, 2026) from a previously forecast 47 yen per share to 56 yen per share, an increase of 9 yen. The total dividend payout for the fiscal year was raised from the prior forecast of 94 yen per share to 112 yen per share, representing an 18-yen increase. The full-year amount comprises the interim dividend of 56 yen and a revised year-end dividend forecast of 56 yen, whereas the previous forecast had been 47 yen interim and 47 yen year-end.

The increases were prompted by upward revision of the company's full-year consolidated earnings forecast announced on the same date. The dividend adjustments align with the company's stated shareholder return policy, which aims for a total shareholder return ratio of 100% through flexible implementation of dividends and share buybacks until ROE reaches 8%, with dividends actively implemented targeting a payout ratio of approximately 70%. The interim dividend becomes effective on December 4, 2026.
